title: {Syn} RLHF Turned Human Preferences Into a Training Signal
content:
Reinforcement learning from human feedback trains models using preference data, often by first fitting a reward model and then optimizing model behavior against it.

It became central in chat assistants because next-token prediction alone does not specify helpfulness, refusal behavior, or conversational style.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
